title: Personality CLAUDE.md files
acceptance: All 4 files exist with all 7 required sections including Patch Awareness. personality-generate skill used.

title: Dungeon generation (rot.js BSP)
acceptance: generateDungeon(seed) returns DungeonMap with ~20 rooms, boss_entrance tile, chest tiles, all tiles initialized.

title: Combat system (pure functions)
acceptance: All 6 functions implemented. calcStaminaCost, calcDamage, calcEquipmentLoad, calcStaminaRegen are pure. resolveCombat handles stamina failure, block reduction, arena bonus.

title: Agent API (Claude calls with personality)
acceptance: callClaude makes real Anthropic API calls. loadPersonalityPrompt reads CLAUDE.md. Model routing: Haiku for dungeon, Sonnet for final. getFallbackAction returns personality-appropriate defaults.

title: Dungeon bridge (FOV filtering)
acceptance: toAgentPayload applies FOV filter correctly. toDashboardPayload includes full map. formatPatchesForAgent implemented.

title: Enemy AI (rule-based, no Claude)
acceptance: resolveEnemyActions handles grunt/brute/sentinel behaviors. Brute telegraphs. Sentinel blocks + summons grunt at 30% HP. pathfindStep uses rot.js A*.

title: Game loop (round lock, parallel calls, phase machine)
acceptance: runDungeonPhase: 4 parallel calls staggered 150ms, round lock, 2s intervals. teleportToArena: score finalization + seeding. runArenaMatch: alternating turns. resolveConflicts: priority ordering. transitionPhase: implemented.

title: Patch applier (atomic writes, ±30% validation)
acceptance: applyPatch validates ±30% of baseline, writes via tmp→rename. getNestedValue and setNestedValue implemented and immutable.

title: State emitter (WebSocket broadcast + event log)
acceptance: broadcast sends DashboardPayload to all ws clients. logEvent appends to game-events.jsonl. broadcastPatch sends patch event immediately.

title: HTTP server (SSE + WebSocket + static files)
acceptance: /api/game-state returns { mode, state }. /api/harness-events SSE streams harness-events.jsonl. /api/build-health reads build-health.json. /ws/game WebSocket works. Dashboard static files served.

title: Headless game runner (acceptance test)
acceptance: Exits 0 and prints GAME_COMPLETE. All 4 agents make ≥1 decision. Dungeon timer fires. Teleport occurs. 2 semis + final resolve. Winner declared. FAST_MODE completes < 90s.

title: Dashboard game view (Phaser + thought panels + patch feed)
acceptance: Phaser scene renders tile map, agent sprites, enemy sprites. Agent thought panels show last reasoning string. Patch feed shows PATCH_APPLIED events via SSE. Responsive to game-state WebSocket updates.

title: Dashboard harness view (task queue + build health)
acceptance: Shows build health grade + history. Streams harness-events.jsonl via /api/harness-events SSE. Grade history sparkline updates in real time.

title: Item system (slots + backpack + equip action)
acceptance: pick_up_item moves ground item to agent backpack. equip_from_backpack swaps item into slot (costs full turn). Item stats apply to combat calculations. Boss kill grants rare item to backpack.

title: demo-start.sh (live demo launcher)
acceptance: Executable shell script at repo root. Reads ANTHROPIC_API_KEY from env (exits with error if unset). Builds and starts game-server/dist/server.js in background. Opens browser to localhost:3000. Runs game-server/run-full-game.js (no --headless) in foreground. Exits cleanly when game ends and kills background server.
